shortBio.en: Guns N' Roses frontman; scream-to-piano range on Appetite and Illusion.
shortBio.zh: Guns N' Roses 主唱；Appetite 与 Illusion 上从尖叫到钢琴的音域。

body.en:
Born 1962. Lead voice of Appetite for Destruction and Use Your Illusion. Holds the brand through mid-90s exits and Chinese Democracy years; reunites with Slash/Duff for stadium tours from 2016.

Vocal method: high scream, mid-baritone verses, piano ballads.
body.zh:
1962 年生。Appetite for Destruction 与 Use Your Illusion 主声。撑过 90 年代中离队与 Chinese Democracy 年；2016 起与 Slash/Duff 重聚体育场巡演。

人声方法：高尖叫、中男中音主歌、钢琴谣曲。
